verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental marketplace that handles customer workloads and data, so a policy or control against using that data for AI training is a fair question. The evidence never mentions a training opt-out or a no-training data policy. Encryption at rest and Confidential Computing nodes are adjacent security controls, not a guarantee against training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
